title: The rise — BYJU'S becomes the world's most valuable edtech
statement: Raveendran built BYJU'S from his test-prep tutoring into a K-12 learning app whose 2015 video-product launch defined Indian edtech for global capital.
outcome: Valuation peaked at $22 billion by 2022, with Tiger Global, Sequoia and the Qatar fund as backers; it was India's most celebrated startup story.

title: The collapse — aggressive sales and hidden loans unwind the company
statement: Sustained by sales practices that locked families into multi-year loans, BYJU'S cracked when the post-COVID cohort expired; founder secrecy about a $1.2 billion term loan and auditor resignation triggered default proceedings.
outcome: Valuation collapsed toward zero; lenders seized control of a US subsidiary, the auditor and board departed, and insolvency proceedings began in 2024 — the largest startup failure in Indian history and the cautionary tale of growth bought with debt.
